speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
title: Closing Remarks
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: President Dallin H. Oaks spoke about “Closing Remarks”.

quotes.text: My dear brothers and sisters, the great messages of this conference and the Spirit of the Lord have inspired all of us to concentrate our worship, focus our learning, and unite our testimonies on the teachings of the Lord Jesus Christ and His Father’s plan for our eternal increase and joy.
quotes.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As the talks of this conference are published, we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain. The Lord has promised, “Unto him that receiveth I will give more.”
quotes.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As we look forward, we are welcoming the world, in person or virtually, to the Salt Lake Temple Celebration. On April 5, 2027, the temple doors will open to the public—the first such opening since 1893, 134 years ago.
quotes.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Following this session of general conference, the first episode of a dynamic video series, Dedicate, will premiere worldwide in multiple languages. More will come in the months ahead, including a virtual tour of the Salt Lake Temple.
quotes.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As we now go forward, we invoke the blessings of the Lord on you and your families, blessings of peace and contentment. And we bless your service of the Lord Jesus Christ in these challenging times.
quotes.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
